scope: Node and isolated DOM/Web Audio substitutes; no browser, phone, GPU timing or human listening

results.name: All 99 authoritative visual marker values match the delivery specification
38 model registries cover 10 states, all anchors and all three render forms
All front/rear forms, portraits and avatars exist and have expected PNG dimensions
Rendering is deterministic and directional state never enters gameplay entities
Six actual hex directions select diagonal views; asymmetric equipment never mirrors
Model timing caps prevent long route animations delaying simulation
100 repeated tap/pan/pinch/cancel/orientation sequences never emit a gesture as an order
Audio waits for a gesture; pause/background stop every score node and scheduling timer
Legacy master mute prevents new score and speech despite enabled new group preferences
Six independent group sliders persist; music and voice mute stop their own outputs
Voice is optional, local only, subtitle capable and respects AI/visibility/cooldown
12 original 192-beat score profiles retain melodic/base/rhythm layers and 90–150s chapter loops
192 local WAV files include three variations plus a short tail; peak, PCM and cache budgets hold
Sample decodes do not replay old events; muted/pause groups stop live FX and file mode uses fallback
Normal/shared layouts and every directional muzzle use the same geometry as the live sprite transform
Seven chapters keep rule/map/trigger/clue IDs while all 23 scene bodies come from the new story source
